content: Lenis ships an official React adapter (lenis/react) exporting ReactLenis provider component and useLenis hook, ties RAF loop into React lifecycle. For GSAP ScrollTrigger sync: drive Lenis via GSAP's ticker (gsap.ticker.add(time => lenis.raf(time*1000)); gsap.ticker.lagSmoothing(0)) and set autoRaf:false on the Lenis instance so there's only one RAF driver; call lenis.on('scroll', ScrollTrigger.update) or rely on ticker-driven updates to avoid jitter/desync.
